objective: Run a paper-grade full-data All-in-One unpaired comparison while continuing evidence-driven reconstruction of one or more UNSB algorithms capable of retaining benefit over 200 data epochs.
guarantees: at least one evidence-derived route-1 candidate and one current-best fallback
traceable code, data, configuration, checkpoint and evaluation identities
one explicit action-priority candidate without deleting the complete evidence-qualified frontier
fixed-e200 full-data trajectories for every authorized paper lane
honest separation of scientific failure, engineering failure and reproduction incomplete
non_guarantees: positive PSNR or successful reproduction of historical methods
completion of the original 400-epoch UNSB schedule
availability of the two additional recommended RTX 4090 hosts before the user supplies them
DDSB reproduction without authoritative source or uniquely specified implementation

saved_compute_priority: an additional independent mechanism before repeated initialization
complete-e200 advancement of strict-pass or causally repairable near-boundary mechanisms

authorization_required.scope: frozen full-data paper lanes plus host-separated small25 evidence-derived candidate research, each after source-bound per-host gates
excludes: paired metric training or scheduling control

change_policy: Every new algorithm requires an evidence-linked derivation card and frozen target-blind gate before paired target metrics are read. A canonical primary does not prune the complete evidence-qualified frontier. Live full-data lanes remain pinned to their scientific commit and protocol fingerprint; newer orchestration cannot mutate them. Confirmation20, cross-host deltas, route2 and unprovided compute remain forbidden without a new explicit decision.
